one_line: V2 two-stage covariance-weighted moment estimator with the measurement family set equal to the dictionary (k_j = b_j), so m = M = 300 and D = G. Everything else is V2: ridge Omega, nonneg L1 selection, tau=1e-3, Omega-weighted simplex refit, V2 coordinate-descent solver.
why: Stage A: equal-weight-per-target geometric ISE ratio vs V2 AKDE is 0.214 (N=500) and 0.063 (N=5000); 39 of 40 paired development replicates improved; no target got worse.

It is a PURE MOMENT estimator: the criterion is still (Du-y)Omega(Du-y), not the empirical L2 loss. The hybrid B4 (moment selection + L2 refit) did not beat it (0.198 / 0.131), so the gain is not attributable to L2 refitting.

Stage B: the alternatives that beat it slightly are not worth their cost or complexity. B3 (same objective solved to KKT tolerance by residual-space FISTA) reaches 0.213 / 0.050 at 7.5x the tuning time. B2 (a frozen sample-size rule that enlarges the bank above N=2000) reaches 0.214 / 0.054 at 1.8x the tuning time and adds a tuned-looking rule to justify.

Mechanism (followup/results/criterion_geometry/): the distance in the exact-ISE metric between the moment criterion unconstrained centre and the L2 centre is 0.95 for the V2 bank, 0.64 for an independent wide-range bank, and 0.028 for this one. The V2 measurement design was aiming at the wrong point in coefficient space, which no weighting matrix can repair.

rejected_alternatives.B1b_moment_wide_indep75x4: independent bank with the same count and the same 0.05-4h range but a different location/scale grid: 0.352 / 0.875, and one target 10.9x worse. Scale coverage alone is not enough; matching the families is what removes the centre offset.
rejected_alternatives.A4_l2_full_simplex: better (0.190 / 0.050) but it is NOT a moment method - it is the empirical integrated-square loss on the full dictionary. Reported as a control, not as the finalist.
rejected_alternatives.B4_hybrid_wide_l2refit: hybrid; reported separately, never as an improvement to moment fitting.
